_about: Conformance cases for a NIS2 scoping classifier: Directive (EU) 2022/2555 Arts. 2 and 3 with the size ceilings of Recommendation 2003/361/EC, plus the national size tests of Slovenia (ZInfV-1), Estonia (KüTS) and Latvia (Nacionālās kiberdrošības likums) and the classes of public administration of Bulgaria (Закон за киберсигурност), Sweden (cybersäkerhetslagen), Czechia (vyhláška č. 408/2025 Sb.), Germany (BSIG), Finland (laki 906/2019), Denmark (NIS 2-loven), Cyprus (Ν. 89(Ι)/2020), Austria (NISG 2026), Belgium (loi du 26 avril 2024), Greece (ν. 5160/2024), Italy (d.lgs. 138/2024), Luxembourg (loi du 5 mai 2026), Malta (S.L. 460.41), the Netherlands (Cyberbeveiligingswet), Slovakia (zákon č. 69/2018 Z. z.), Croatia (NN 14/2024), Poland (ustawa o krajowym systemie cyberbezpieczeństwa), Portugal (Decreto-Lei n.º 125/2025) and Romania (OUG nr. 155/2024). Inputs use the Reglyze questionnaire ids; amounts are in euros; a missing annual_balance_sheet means the entity did not state one; `sector: "manufacturing"` stands for the Annex II point 5 manufacturing types (NACE C26 to C30 and medical devices), not manufacturing at large. `expected` is derived from the texts quoted in legal-sources/eu.md and legal-sources/slovenia.md; the Reglyze engine is checked against every case when this file is generated. Not modelled: domain-name registrars (Art. 2(4)), critical entities under Directive (EU) 2022/2557 (Art. 2(3)), partner and linked enterprises (Recommendation Annex Art. 6), Member-State extensions to local administration (Art. 2(5)), national sector rules such as the Polish MSSP rule.

cases.title: 18 employees, EUR 2.6M turnover, EUR 2M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Small enterprise: fewer than 50 staff and turnover not exceeding EUR 10M (Recommendation Annex Art. 2(2)); outside Directive Art. 2(1).

cases.title: 30 employees, EUR 12M turnover, EUR 5M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Still small: the balance sheet does not exceed EUR 10M and one financial ceiling suffices (the Annex says 'and/or').

cases.title: 30 employees, EUR 12M turnover, EUR 12M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Not small: both financial ceilings exceeded; an Annex II medium enterprise is an important entity (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: 50 employees, EUR 9M turnover, EUR 8M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Headcount alone makes it medium: 'fewer than 50 persons' is the small ceiling (Recommendation Annex Art. 2(2)).

cases.title: 100 employees, EUR 60M turnover, EUR 30M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: Does not exceed the medium ceilings: that needs 250 staff, or turnover above 50M and a balance sheet above 43M (Recommendation Annex Art. 2(1)); an Annex I medium enterprise is important (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: 100 employees, EUR 60M turnover, EUR 44M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: Exceeds the medium ceilings on both financial limbs; a large Annex I entity is essential (Art. 3(1)(a)).

cases.title: 250 employees, EUR 3M turnover, EUR 2M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: 250 staff exceeds the medium ceilings, but Art. 3(1)(a) covers Annex I only; a large Annex II entity is important (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: 300 employees, EUR 5M turnover, EUR 4M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: Headcount alone exceeds the medium ceilings; a large Annex I entity is essential (Art. 3(1)(a)).

cases.title: 10 employees, exactly EUR 10M turnover and EUR 10M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: 'Does not exceed EUR 10 million' (Recommendation Annex Art. 2(2)): the boundary value stays small.

cases.title: exactly 250 employees, EUR 5M turnover, EUR 4M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: 'Fewer than 250 persons' is the medium ceiling (Recommendation Annex Art. 2(1)): 250 staff exceeds it, whatever the money; a large Annex I entity is essential (Art. 3(1)(a)).

cases.title: 100 employees, exactly EUR 50M turnover, EUR 60M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: 'Not exceeding EUR 50 million' (Recommendation Annex Art. 2(1)): the boundary value respects the turnover ceiling, and one financial ceiling suffices; a medium Annex I entity is important (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: 100 employees, EUR 60M turnover, exactly EUR 43M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: 'Not exceeding EUR 43 million' (Recommendation Annex Art. 2(1)): the boundary value respects the balance-sheet ceiling, and one financial ceiling suffices; a medium Annex I entity is important (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: 5-person cloud computing provider
cases.basis: Cloud computing is an Annex I digital-infrastructure activity but is not in the closed list of Art. 2(2)(a); the size test of Art. 2(1) applies.

cases.title: 5-person data-centre provider
cases.basis: Same as cloud: an Annex I activity subject to the size test.

cases.title: 5-person content delivery network provider
cases.basis: Same as cloud: an Annex I activity subject to the size test.

cases.title: 5-person DNS service provider
cases.basis: Art. 2(2)(a)(iii): in scope regardless of size; Art. 3(1)(b): essential regardless of size.

cases.title: 5-person top-level domain name registry
cases.basis: Art. 2(2)(a)(iii) and Art. 3(1)(b).

cases.title: 5-person qualified trust service provider
cases.basis: Art. 2(2)(a)(ii) and Art. 3(1)(b).

cases.title: 5-person non-qualified trust service provider
cases.basis: In scope regardless of size (Art. 2(2)(a)(ii)); not named in Art. 3(1), so important (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: 5-person provider of public electronic communications networks
cases.basis: Art. 2(2)(a)(i): in scope regardless of size; Art. 3(1)(c) makes only providers that qualify as medium-sized enterprises essential; Art. 3(2) otherwise.

cases.title: 80-person public electronic communications provider, EUR 20M turnover, EUR 15M balance sheet
cases.basis: A medium-sized provider of public electronic communications is essential (Art. 3(1)(c)).

cases.title: central-government administration, 8 staff
cases.basis: Art. 2(2)(f)(i): in scope regardless of size; Art. 3(1)(d): essential.

cases.title: regional administration, 8 staff
cases.basis: Regional administration is in scope once the Member State's risk-based assessment brings it in (Art. 2(2)(f)(ii)); Art. 3(1)(d) covers point (f)(i) only, so it is important under Art. 3(2).

cases.title: sole provider of a service essential to critical societal activities, 12 staff, manufacturing
cases.basis: Art. 2(2)(b): in scope regardless of size where the Member State so identifies; Art. 3(2), second sentence, makes it important unless identified as essential (Art. 3(1)(e)).

cases.title: designated essential by the Member State, 20 staff, manufacturing
cases.basis: Art. 3(1)(e): an entity the Member State identified as essential is essential, whatever its size.

cases.title: 60 employees, EUR 5M turnover, EUR 4M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: ZInfV-1 Art. 6(1) is cumulative: at least 50 employees AND an annual turnover or balance sheet total of at least EUR 10M; the financial limb fails.

cases.title: 40 employees, EUR 12M turnover, EUR 12M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Fails the 50-employee limb of Art. 6(1), although the directive's own yardstick would put it in scope.

cases.title: exactly 50 employees and EUR 10M turnover, EUR 1M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: 'Vsaj' (at least) makes both thresholds inclusive; an obliged Annex 2 entity is important (Art. 7(3)).

cases.title: 120 employees, EUR 30M turnover, EUR 20M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: General test of Art. 6(1) met; the thresholds of Art. 7(2) pt 1 concern Annex 1 types only, so an obliged Annex 2 entity is important (Art. 7(3)).

cases.title: 60 employees, EUR 50M turnover, EUR 10M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: Art. 7(2) pt 1 is disjunctive: at least 250 employees OR turnover of at least EUR 50M OR a balance sheet total of at least EUR 43M; EUR 50M alone suffices once the general test is met.

cases.title: 10 employees, EUR 60M turnover, EUR 50M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: Art. 7 classifies only entities obliged under Art. 6; the cumulative general test fails on headcount.

cases.title: 5-person cloud or hosting company
cases.basis: Cloud is not among the any-size types of Art. 6(2); Art. 6(1) fails.

cases.title: 5-person DNS service provider
cases.basis: Art. 6(2) pt 1 and Art. 7(2) pt 2: essential regardless of size.

cases.title: 5-person provider of public electronic communications networks
cases.basis: Art. 6(2) pt 1: in scope regardless of size; Art. 7(2) pt 3 reserves essential for 50 employees and EUR 10M; Art. 7(3) otherwise.

cases.title: urban municipality (mestna občina), 40 staff
cases.basis: Art. 6(3) pt 4 (urban municipalities) and Art. 7(3).

cases.title: state-level body, 40 staff
cases.basis: Art. 6(2) pt 6 and Art. 7(2) pt 4.

cases.title: 60 employees, EUR 5M turnover, EUR 4M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: KüTS § 3(5) is cumulative: 50 or more employees AND an annual balance sheet total or turnover above EUR 10 million. The money limb fails, although the Recommendation's yardstick would make it a medium enterprise.

cases.title: 40 employees, EUR 12M turnover, EUR 12M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Fails the 50-employee limb of KüTS § 3(5), although the directive's own yardstick would put it in scope.

cases.title: exactly 50 employees and EUR 10M on both figures, manufacturing
cases.basis: 'Ületab' (exceeds) is exclusive: exactly EUR 10 million does not pass the money limb of KüTS § 3(5).

cases.title: 50 employees, EUR 10,000,001 turnover, EUR 1M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: One euro above EUR 10 million on one figure passes: the money limb is 'balance sheet total or turnover'. An Annex II type that meets the test is important (KüTS § 3(5)).

cases.title: 300 employees, EUR 5M on both figures, energy
cases.basis: The general test is cumulative (KüTS § 3(4) point 8): headcount alone does not oblige. Under the Recommendation's yardstick it is large, and essential under the directive.

cases.title: 300 employees, EUR 20M on both figures, energy
cases.basis: Meets the general test but not the essential one, which needs 250 or more employees AND a balance sheet total above EUR 43 million or a turnover above EUR 50 million (KüTS § 3(3)): important (§ 3(4) point 8).

cases.title: 250 employees, EUR 20M turnover, EUR 43,000,001 balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: KüTS § 3(3): 250 or more employees and a balance sheet total above EUR 43 million; an Annex I type that § 3(3) lists is essential.

cases.title: 249 employees, EUR 60M turnover, EUR 50M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: KüTS § 3(3) is cumulative: no amount makes an entity essential below 250 employees. It meets the general test, so it is important (§ 3(4) point 8).

cases.title: 60-person provider of public electronic communications, EUR 5M on both figures
cases.basis: Below the test of KüTS § 3(2) point 8 (50 or more employees and a balance sheet total or turnover above EUR 10 million): in scope regardless of size as an important entity (§ 3(4) point 9). The directive makes a medium-sized provider essential (Art. 3(1)(c)).

cases.title: non-qualified trust service provider, 300 employees, EUR 60M turnover, EUR 50M balance sheet
cases.basis: KüTS § 3(4) point 7: important at any size. The types § 3(3) lists include no trust service, so no size makes it essential, where the directive makes a large one essential (Art. 3(1)(a)).

cases.title: local government unit, 12 staff
cases.basis: KüTS § 3(2) point 4: a local government unit is an essential entity regardless of size. The directive leaves local administration to the Member State (Art. 2(5)(a)).

cases.title: 250 employees, exactly EUR 50M turnover and EUR 43M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: 'Ületab' is exclusive in the essential test too: the boundary values do not pass KüTS § 3(3). It meets the general test, so it is important (§ 3(4) point 8).

cases.title: managed service provider, 120 employees, EUR 6M turnover, EUR 3M balance sheet
cases.basis: Neither a large operator (Nacionālās kiberdrošības likums Art. 1(16)) nor a medium one (Art. 1(25)): below 250 employees only a turnover or a balance sheet total of at least EUR 10 million opens the act. The Recommendation's yardstick would make it medium.

cases.title: 30 employees, EUR 12M turnover, EUR 5M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Medium under Art. 1(25): a turnover of at least EUR 10 million suffices, and the act sets no headcount floor. A medium operator of a type listed in Art. 21(1)(2) is important. The Recommendation would make it small.

cases.title: 100 employees, EUR 60M turnover, EUR 5M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: Large under Art. 1(16) on turnover alone: the limbs are joined by 'vai' (or) since 18 June 2026. A large operator of a type listed in Art. 20(8) is essential. The Recommendation needs both financial figures.

cases.title: 100 employees, exactly EUR 50M turnover and EUR 43M balance sheet, energy
cases.basis: 'Pārsniedz' (exceeds) is exclusive and 'nepārsniedz' inclusive: the boundary values are medium (Art. 1(25)). A medium operator of a type listed in Art. 20(8) is important (Art. 21(1)(1)).

cases.title: 250 employees, EUR 1M on both figures, energy
cases.basis: 'Vismaz 250' (at least 250) is inclusive: large on headcount alone (Art. 1(16)); a large operator of a type listed in Art. 20(8) is essential.

cases.title: 249 employees, EUR 1M on both figures, energy
cases.basis: Below 250 employees only money opens the act, and neither figure reaches EUR 10 million (Art. 1(25)). The Recommendation's yardstick would make it medium.

cases.title: 300 employees, EUR 60M turnover, EUR 50M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: A large operator of a type listed in Art. 21(1)(2) stays important: Art. 20(8) does not list it.

cases.title: 5-person provider of public electronic communications
cases.basis: Art. 20(3): every electronic communications undertaking is an essential entity, whatever its size. The directive makes one below medium size important (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: non-qualified trust service provider, 300 employees, EUR 60M turnover, EUR 50M balance sheet
cases.basis: Art. 21(1)(6): important at any size; a qualified one is essential (Art. 20(4)). The types listed in Art. 20(8) include no trust service, where the directive makes a large provider essential (Art. 3(1)(a)).

cases.title: municipality, 12 staff
cases.basis: Art. 20(6): a municipality is a derived public person, an essential entity regardless of size. The directive leaves local administration to the Member State (Art. 2(5)(a)).

cases.title: 30 employees, exactly EUR 10M turnover, EUR 1M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: 'Vismaz 10 miljoni' (at least EUR 10 million) is inclusive, on either figure alone: medium under Art. 1(25), and a medium operator of a type listed in Art. 21(1)(2) is important.

cases.title: municipal administration headed by the mayor, 30 staff
cases.basis: Закон за киберсигурност Art. 4, т. 1 puts administrative bodies in scope with no condition of size, and Art. 4а(1), т. 4 makes them essential entities. An administrative body is a body that belongs to the executive power (supplementary provisions, § 3, т. 1), and in a municipality that body is the mayor (Constitution, Art. 139(1)). The directive leaves local administration to the Member State (Art. 2(5)(a)).

cases.title: regional administration headed by the regional governor, 30 staff
cases.basis: Art. 4, т. 1 and Art. 4а(1), т. 4, as for bg-01. The Constitution has the region governed by a regional governor whom the Council of Ministers appoints, for state governance there (Arts 142 and 143): an administrative body on that reading. The act that lists the bodies of executive power is not on the record, and the record says so. Under the directive alone a regional entity is important (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: ministry, 8 staff
cases.basis: Art. 4, т. 1 and Art. 4а(1), т. 4: the class the directive also gives central government (Art. 3(1)(d)), reached here through the act's own rule.

cases.title: 80 employees, EUR 15M turnover, EUR 12M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Art. 4, т. 2: an Annex I or II type that meets the medium test of Art. 3(1) of the Bulgarian SME act, whose ceilings are the Recommendation's (fewer than 250 staff; EUR 50M turnover and/or EUR 43M balance sheet). Not essential under Art. 4а(1), so important (Art. 4а(2)).

cases.title: 30 employees, EUR 12M turnover, EUR 5M balance sheet, manufacturing
cases.basis: Small under Art. 3(2) of the SME act: fewer than 50 staff and a turnover and/or a balance sheet total not exceeding EUR 10M, so one financial ceiling suffices, as in the Recommendation. Below the test of Art. 4, т. 2.

cases.title: municipality, 4,200 staff, EUR 480M turnover, EUR 390M balance sheet
cases.basis: Cybersäkerhetslagen (2025:1506) puts every region, municipality and kommunalförbund under the act (1 kap. 3 § 2), and a municipality or a region larger than a medium enterprise is an essential entity (1 kap. 9 § 2 a). The directive leaves local administration to the Member State (Art. 2(5)(a)).

cases.title: municipality, 120 staff, EUR 14M turnover, EUR 11M balance sheet
cases.basis: Under the act whatever its size (1 kap. 3 § 2). Not larger than a medium enterprise, so not essential under 1 kap. 9 § 2 a, and whoever is not essential is important (1 kap. 9 § second paragraph).

cases.title: region, 12,000 staff, EUR 2.1bn turnover, EUR 1.4bn balance sheet
cases.basis: 1 kap. 3 § 2 and 9 § 2 a: a region larger than a medium enterprise is an essential entity. Under the directive alone a regional entity is important unless the Member State identifies it as essential (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: municipality, exactly 250 staff, EUR 1M on both figures
cases.basis: The government's bill reads 'larger than a medium enterprise' as at least 250 persons, or a turnover above EUR 50 million and a balance sheet total above EUR 43 million: 250 persons suffice (1 kap. 9 § 2 a). Neither the act nor the bill says how a municipality's figures are counted; the figures are taken as given.

cases.title: municipality, 249 staff, EUR 60M turnover, exactly EUR 43M balance sheet
cases.basis: Below 250 persons both amounts must be exceeded, and the balance sheet total is not above EUR 43 million: not larger than a medium enterprise, so important (1 kap. 9 § second paragraph).

cases.title: state authority, 40 staff
cases.basis: 1 kap. 9 § 1: a state authority under the act is an essential entity. The act covers one with the power to take decisions affecting rights in cross-border movement (1 kap. 3 § 1) and those the government designates (1 kap. 8 §); the case assumes one of them.

cases.title: region (kraj), 900 staff
cases.basis: Annex to vyhláška č. 408/2025 Sb., row 1.1, part I, letter s: a region provides a regulated service in the regime of higher obligations, which the decree's explanatory memorandum equates with the directive's essential entities. Under the directive alone a regional entity is important unless the Member State identifies it as essential (Art. 3(2)).

cases.title: region (kraj), 30 staff
cases.basis: Row 1.1 sets no size condition, and a territorial self-governing unit is not an enterprise for the size test (zákon č. 264/2025 Sb., § 7(b)): the regime does not depend on the figures.

cases.title: municipality with extended powers, 180 staff
cases.basis: Row 1.1, part II, letter e: a municipality with extended powers is in the regime of lower obligations, the counterpart of the directive's important entities (§ 18(4) of zákon č. 264/2025 Sb. pairs the two regimes with the two classes). The inputs cannot tell it from a municipality the row does not list, which does not provide the regulated service: the questionnaire asks the level of government, not the kind of municipality.

cases.title: federal authority, 40 staff
cases.basis: § 29 Abs. 1 and 2 BSIG: the rules for particularly important entities apply to a body of the federal administration, with no size test.

cases.title: municipality, 900 staff, no other sector
cases.basis: § 29 BSIG covers the federal level only and neither Anlage lists public administration; Art. 2(5)(a) leaves local administration to the Member State.

cases.title: Landkreis, 30 staff, no other sector
cases.basis: § 29 BSIG covers the federal level only and neither Anlage lists public administration; Art. 2(5)(a) leaves local administration to the Member State.

cases.title: municipal unit selling drinking water, 300 staff
cases.basis: § 28 Abs. 1 Nr. 4 BSIG and Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1: a legally dependent unit of a territorial authority that offers services for payment, at least 250 staff.

cases.title: municipal unit selling drinking water, 80 staff
cases.basis: § 28 Abs. 2 Nr. 3 BSIG and Anlage 1 Nr. 5.1.1: at least 50 staff, fewer than 250.

cases.title: municipal waste service, 20 staff, EUR 2M on both figures
cases.basis: § 28 Abs. 2 Nr. 3 BSIG and Anlage 2 Nr. 2.1.1: below both tests, and the public administration of a municipality brings nothing in.

cases.title: administration of a Land, 5,000 staff
cases.basis: Art. 2(2)(f)(ii) and Art. 3(2): the directive's reading, kept because the federal act does not cover a Land (§ 29 BSIG) and the law of the Länder is not on the record.

cases.title: state agency, 40 staff
cases.basis: § 18 a(1) of laki 906/2019, chapter added by 125/2025: the bodies in the chapter's scope are essential entities of the sector, with no size test.

cases.title: wellbeing services county, 9,000 staff
cases.basis: § 18 a(1), second sentence, of laki 906/2019: wellbeing services counties are important entities, whatever their size.

cases.title: wellbeing services joint authority, 30 staff
cases.basis: § 18 a(1), second sentence, of laki 906/2019: joint authorities are important entities, whatever their size.

cases.title: municipality, 900 staff, no other sector
cases.basis: § 3(3) point 4 of laki 906/2019 leaves municipal authorities out of chapter 4 a, and § 4(6) of kyberturvallisuuslaki 124/2025 reaches a municipality only for its Annex activities and as a critical entity.

cases.title: municipal waterworks, 300 staff
cases.basis: § 4(6), § 3(1), § 27(2) and Annex I point 14 of kyberturvallisuuslaki 124/2025: the Annex activity is decided by the size test, and a large Annex I type is essential.

cases.title: municipal waterworks, 80 staff
cases.basis: § 4(6), § 3(1) and Annex I point 14 of kyberturvallisuuslaki 124/2025: a medium Annex activity is under the act and is not essential.

cases.title: central government body, 30 staff
cases.basis: § 4, stk. 3, nr. 2 of the NIS 2-loven: central government is essential whatever its size.

cases.title: region, 30,000 staff
cases.basis: Bilag 1, pkt. 10 and § 4, stk. 1 of the NIS 2-loven: an Annex 1 type with 250 persons or more.

cases.title: regional body, 120 staff
cases.basis: Bilag 1, pkt. 10 and § 5, stk. 1 of the NIS 2-loven: an Annex 1 type from 50 persons, not essential.

cases.title: regional body, 20 staff, EUR 2M on both figures
cases.basis: §§ 4 and 5 of the NIS 2-loven: below both tests, the act giving no any-size class to the regional level.

cases.title: municipality, 2,000 staff, no other sector
cases.basis: Bilag 1, pkt. 10 of the NIS 2-loven lists the central and regional levels, and § 1, stk. 7 needs an executive order for local administration.

cases.title: municipality providing healthcare, 2,000 staff
cases.basis: Bill L 141, remarks to § 1: a municipality acting as a healthcare provider is under the act as a whole; § 4, stk. 1 of the NIS 2-loven at 250 persons or more.

cases.title: ministry, 60 staff
cases.basis: Art. 2Α(2)(στ)(i) and Art. 27(1)(α)(iv) of Ν. 89(Ι)/2020 as amended by Ν. 60(Ι)/2025.

cases.title: body of the wider public sector, 300 staff
cases.basis: Art. 2Α(2)(στ)(ii) and Art. 27(2) of Ν. 89(Ι)/2020 as amended: the wider public sector stands in the place of the regional level.

cases.title: municipality, 30 staff
cases.basis: Art. 2Α(5) and Art. 27(2) of Ν. 89(Ι)/2020 as amended: the law takes in local administration, with no size test.

cases.title: federal authority, 40 staff
cases.basis: § 24 Abs. 1 Z 1 lit. d NISG 2026: the federal level, whatever the size.

cases.title: office of a Land government, 30 staff
cases.basis: § 24 Abs. 2 Z 2 and Abs. 5 NISG 2026: the Land level, with no size test.

cases.title: municipality, 900 staff, no other sector
cases.basis: § 24 Abs. 3 NISG 2026 excludes municipalities and their associations from the sector.

cases.title: municipal waterworks, 300 staff
cases.basis: § 24 Abs. 1 Z 3 NISG 2026: a large undertaking of a type in Anlage 1.

cases.title: federal public service, 40 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3, § 3, 3°, a and art. 9, 4° of the loi du 26 avril 2024.

cases.title: regional administration identified by the authority, 300 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3, § 3, 3°, b, art. 11, § 2 and art. 10, 1° of the loi du 26 avril 2024: identified, and not essential.

cases.title: fire-rescue zone, 30 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3, § 3, 3°, c and art. 10, 1° of the loi du 26 avril 2024.

cases.title: ministry, 60 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3 § 2 στ) στα) and art. 4 § 1 δ) of ν. 5160/2024.

cases.title: region, second-tier local authority, 900 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3 § 2 στ) στγ) and art. 4 § 2 of ν. 5160/2024.

cases.title: municipality, first-tier local authority, 30 staff
ministry, 60 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3 c. 6 and art. 6 c. 1 lett. e of d.lgs. 138/2024.

cases.title: region, 900 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3 c. 6, Allegato III c. 1 lett. b and art. 6 c. 3 of d.lgs. 138/2024.

cases.title: municipality above 100,000 inhabitants, 900 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3 c. 6, Allegato III c. 1 lett. c and art. 6 c. 3 of d.lgs. 138/2024.

cases.title: ministry, 60 staff
cases.basis: Art. 1(2) 6° and Art. 11(1) 4° of the loi du 5 mai 2026.

cases.title: commune meeting the four criteria of Art. 2, 34°, 12 staff
cases.basis: Art. 1(2) 6° and Art. 11(1) 4° of the loi du 5 mai 2026: the act names no level.

cases.title: communal syndicate meeting the four criteria, 300 staff
cases.basis: Art. 1(2) 6° and Art. 11(1) 4° of the loi du 5 mai 2026: the act names no level.

cases.title: government entity, 60 staff
local council with a positive risk assessment, 30 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3(3)(f) and art. 4(2) of S.L. 460.41.

cases.title: local council with a positive risk assessment, 300 staff
cases.basis: Art. 3(3)(f) and art. 4(2) of S.L. 460.41: no size test.

cases.title: ministry, 60 staff
cases.basis: Art. 8 lid 1 onder g Cyberbeveiligingswet.

cases.title: province, 900 staff
cases.basis: Art. 8 lid 1 onder h Cyberbeveiligingswet.

cases.title: municipality, 60 staff
cases.basis: Art. 8 lid 1 onder h Cyberbeveiligingswet: by operation of law, with no size test.

cases.title: central state body, 40 staff
higher territorial unit with significant impact, 300 staff
cases.basis: § 17(1)(d) of zákon č. 69/2018 Z. z.: on a significance test, the act having no word for an important entity.

cases.title: town with significant impact, 60 staff
cases.basis: § 17(1)(f) of zákon č. 69/2018 Z. z.: on a significance test, the act having no word for an important entity.

cases.title: state administration body, 40 staff
cases.basis: Čl. 12. st. 1. of the Zakon o kibernetičkoj sigurnosti (NN 14/2024).

cases.title: county with a positive assessment, 300 staff
cases.basis: Čl. 12. st. 3. of the Zakon o kibernetičkoj sigurnosti: whatever the size, after an assessment.

cases.title: municipality with a positive assessment, 12 staff
cases.basis: Čl. 12. st. 3. of the Zakon o kibernetičkoj sigurnosti: whatever the size, after an assessment.

cases.title: ministry, 60 staff
cases.basis: Art. 5 ust. 1 pkt 4 lit. d of the ustawa o krajowym systemie cyberbezpieczeństwa, Annex 1.

cases.title: voivodeship budget unit, 30 staff
cases.basis: Art. 5 ust. 1 pkt 4 lit. d, Annex 1, public entities, point 2.

cases.title: municipal office, exactly 50 full-time staff
cases.basis: Annex 1, public entities, point 4: a municipal office from 50 full-time staff on 1 January.

cases.title: municipal office, 49 full-time staff
